tools.name: post_intent
tools.description: Record a buy intent. Free. Does not charge or hold funds.

tools.name: post_offer
tools.description: Record a vendor ask against a spec hash. Free. No inventory held here. Merchant stays merchant of record.

tools.name: list_demand
tools.description: Read clustered hashes with intent, offer, search, and miss counts. Signal only. Not a fill.

tools.name: cover_intent
tools.description: Attach a posted offer to a buy intent. No deposits. No order placement.

tools.name: search_supply
tools.description: Free supply scan. Every query is written to the demand tape. Misses become implicit intents.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Free live quote. Mixes vendor offers and catalog. Every spec is written to the demand tape. Does not place orders.

tools.name: open_checkout
tools.description: Return merchant product/checkout URL for a quote. Does not complete payment.

tools.name: open_pool
tools.description: Cluster intents by spec hash. No deposits.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_checkout · Private data: post_intent, post_offer · Public sink: post_intent, post_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_checkout · Private data: post_intent, post_offer · Public sink: post_intent, post_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
